classification: The Web authority already preserves thread-scoped Composer drafts. Native previously discarded text when its keyed Composer unmounted and did not hydrate the host textarea from restored state. The current implementation moves text ownership into a stable thread-or-project scoped client projection, debounces it into isolated preferences, and keeps the Lynx textarea as a capability leaf. Exact-bundle Native leaves the draft for the same persisted canonical thread, returns to the same draft ID, then cold-restarts into a second owned PID and restores the project draft with send semantics. Both phases use main transport, report zero renderer errors, and dispose isolated state. Connector reconnect and attachment/context lifecycles remain open, so PF2 stays in progress.
